turns.text: I look at her and have to smile
turns.zh: 我看着她，忍不住笑了

turns.text: As we go driving for a while
turns.zh: 我们开着车，开了一会儿

turns.text: Her hair blowing in the open window of my car
turns.zh: 她的头发在车窗边随风飘动

turns.text: And as we go, the traffic lights
turns.zh: 我们一路开着，红绿灯

turns.text: I watch them glimmer in her eyes
turns.zh: 我看着它们在她的眼里闪烁

turns.text: In the darkness of the evening
turns.zh: 在傍晚的暮色里

turns.text: And I've got all that I need
turns.zh: 我已经拥有了我需要的一切

turns.text: Right here in the passenger seat
turns.zh: 就在副驾驶座上

turns.text: And I can't keep my eyes on the road
turns.zh: 我没办法把视线从路上移开

turns.text: Knowing that she's inches from me
turns.zh: 知道她就在我身边几英寸的地方

turns.text: We stop to get something to drink
turns.zh: 我们停下来买点喝的

turns.text: My mind clouds and I can't think
turns.zh: 我的脑子一片模糊，什么都想不了

turns.text: Scared to death to say I love her
turns.zh: 害怕得要命，不敢说我爱她

turns.text: Then the moon peeks from the clouds
turns.zh: 然后月亮从云层里探出头来

turns.text: I hear my heart, it beats so loud
turns.zh: 我听到我的心跳，跳得好大声

turns.text: Try to tell her simply
turns.zh: 试着简单地告诉她

turns.text: That I've got all that I need
turns.zh: 我已经拥有了我需要的一切

turns.text: Right here in the passenger seat
turns.zh: 就在副驾驶座上

turns.text: Oh, and I can't keep my eyes on the road
turns.zh: 哦，我没办法把视线从路上移开

turns.zh: 这份爱会生长
